fields.description: Issue includes investigative and editorial coverage of Florida Power & Light billing and electric-rate regulation; allegations of abuse and misconduct by Dr. T. Earl Moore ("Torture Doctor") and calls for action by medical authorities and Gov. Warren; discussion of gambling enforcement and proposed legislation affecting bookmaking and racing (including arguments against summer dog racing in Miami); local court and civic items; notices of cultural events (including a Freedom House Forum program) and community activities; and commentary on employment-agency rackets and tax-avoidance foundations.
